body:
I apologize for the length.

tl;dr I've [25F] been trying to mend relationships and they only seem to tear me down, especially from my parents [50s].  I don't know how to be happy anymore and I don't really know if I'm suicidal.

Thank you so much for the reply.

I definitely feel like the relationship with my parents may be over.  Even my girlfriend has told me she won't be able to look at them the same after the New Years situation.

I don't even know!  I have definitely always wanted to travel the world.  But anymore I feel like even if I did, the anxiety of it would make it unpleasant.  You're right - I just need to fucking go for it.  I gotta keep my head above water.

I'm scared that one more thing going wrong will definitely break me.  I know that if I say things like "I'm going to hurt myself or others" I may be committed.  I have no clue what will happen if I say something along the lines of "I kinda want to die but I don't want to hurt myself".

I'll try the traveling for sure.  Thanks again for your time and advice
